_comment: BOOTSTRAP IMPORTER POLICY — writes entity/edge/fact instances to data/lake only. No society or road names here.
description: Bootstrap importer policy. Writes entity instances and edges to the lake only — never back into app/config/.
notes: Gate coordinates from visuals are geometry hints, not verified road identity.
Edges are emitted only when inference confidence meets edge_inference.min_confidence.
Re-bootstrap and re-enrichment are safe: facts are versioned in the lake.
